title: vLLM usage statistics are on
explanation: vLLM posts usage statistics (CPU, memory and GPU details, platform, model architecture, vLLM version and a random per-process id) to https://stats.vllm.ai when the engine starts, unless it is opted out. Setting VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1, VLLM_DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 (exactly "1"), or creating ~/.config/vllm/do_not_track, turns it off. Note that upstream treats a set but non-"1" VLLM_DO_NOT_TRACK as overriding DO_NOT_TRACK; this rule does not model that.

evidence.detail: vllm 0.32.0 installed; not disabled in the image (none of DO_NOT_TRACK=1, VLLM_DO_NOT_TRACK=1, VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1); no matching config file

fix: Set VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 in the image environment, or create /root/.config/vllm/do_not_track (the opt-out file) in the image.
